description: All eight benchmark problems, M1 RK1 and mixed-frame FLD, levels 2/3/4; explicit start required
scope: 48 uniform-grid runs: eight problems, both models, levels 2/3/4 (32/64/128 cells per side). 121 requested physical snapshots and 60-second movies. Positive streaming optical depth 1e-4 for both models. Full shock/blast durations, longer Gaussian/Marshak evolution. Preserve validated samples and initial/final 3D states; retire intermediate 3D files only after verified extraction. First-order moving FLD uses a serial root-gathered composite solve and remains subject to memory limits. Full-resolution runtime and timestep convergence are unverified. Start only on explicit command.
